title: Machine Learning Engineering Manager II
description:
What You'll Do
Lead and grow a team of machine learning, backend, and data engineers, supporting their development and helping them deliver their best work.Shape the team's technical strategy and execution, ensuring engineering efforts align with listener needs and Spotify's broader business goals. Guide the development of machine learning and recommendation systems that balance multiple objectives across personalized listening experiences. Collaborate with Product and engineering partners to define priorities, align on outcomes, and translate complex challenges into clear plans. Support the team in making thoughtful technical decisions across experimentation, scalability, system reliability, and model performance. Create a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement, where engineers feel empowered to experiment and learn. Drive effective planning and delivery while balancing immediate priorities with long-term technical health. Foster an inclusive, supportive team environment through coaching, feedback, and thoughtful people leadership.
Who You Are
You have experience managing and developing engineering teams, with a track record of helping people grow and delivering impactful results. You bring a strong technical background in machine learning, software engineering, or related areas, and can confidently guide technical conversations. You understand the opportunities and challenges of developing and operating machine learning systems in production. You have experience working with cross-functional partners to define priorities, navigate trade-offs, and deliver against shared goals. You are comfortable leading teams through ambiguity and helping engineers make informed technical decisions. You care about building inclusive, collaborative environments where people feel supported and empowered. You communicate with clarity, lead with empathy, and know how to balance people, technology, and business needs
Where You'll Be
We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! For this role, you can be within the North Americas region as long as we have a work location. This team operates within the Eastern Standard time zone for collaboration.
Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.
 
At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.
